# T-1: Add implementation repair states

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add impl-triage and impl-repair as first-class flow leaves with review PASS/FAIL routing and unconditional post-repair test-execute re-entry.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Flow definition, status, and next-action expose impl-triage and impl-repair.
- Implementation review PASS skips repair work and reaches impl-gate.
- Implementation review FAIL reaches impl-triage, applied triage reaches impl-repair, and repair completion reaches test-execute.
- Acceptance notMet findings can enter the same impl-triage contract.

## Implementation Notes
Update definition-derived lifecycle ranges and impl prompt sources without duplicating step-order maps. Use dedicated triage/repair value classes and keep existing command registry ownership.

## Test Strategy
Focused unit tests cover definition order, next-action/status visibility, PASS skip behavior, FAIL routing, and repeated repair-cycle resets.
